title: TikTok: How billionaires pay $0 in tax (Video 9)

lines.text: In 2011, one of the richest men alive paid zero dollars in federal income tax. Legally.
A delivery driver pays thousands. So how do billionaires do it? Three steps.
Step one: buy shares, and never sell them. No sale means no tax on the gains.
Step two: borrow against them to pay for your life. A loan is not income, so it is not taxed.
Step three: die. Your kids inherit the shares, and the old gains are never taxed.
Should this be allowed? Yes or no? Tell me in the comments.
